a.description: Adult Zhang Lingyu, beautiful dignified ascetic face, silver-white long hair half tied with dark ornament, white layered embroidered Taoist robe and dark waist sash. Serious calm eyes. Episode 2 battle: holds one plain matte-black wireless handheld microphone in his RIGHT hand at chin level, lips always visible; free left hand for gestures.

b.description: Adult Zhang Chulan, messy black hair, sly crooked closed smile, navy work jacket over white tee with orange-red collar, dark work trousers. Episode 2 battle: holds one plain matte-black wireless handheld microphone in his RIGHT hand at chin level, lips always visible; free left hand for agile gestures.

tianshi.description: Lao Tianshi Zhang Zhiwei, dignified venerable elder with radiant evenly toned clean ivory skin, NO black spots, NO brown age spots or uneven pigmentation. Natural delicate elder wrinkles remain. Serene wise clear eyes, pure airy silver-white brows, long white beard and elegant white topknot. Black Taoist robe, grey cloud-jacquard collar, white inner collar, carved central judge chair. 仙风道骨、鹤发童颜、清癯高古。

lu_jin.description: Venerable Lu Jin, long straight center-parted white hair, white moustache and chin beard, stern watery eyes, black suit and white shirt, seated carved left judge chair, a white handkerchief kept low.

feng_zhenghao.description: Middle-aged Feng Zhenghao, slicked-back grey-white hair, round wire glasses, slate-blue double-breasted suit over blue polka-dot shirt, composed calculating smile, carved right judge chair.

xu_si.description: Adult Xu Si, tousled short silver hair, faint chin goatee/stubble, khaki jacket with small brass collar bars, white scoop tee and silver chain, plain matte-black wireless microphone low at sternum.

xu_san.description: Adult Xu San, neat short dark hair, rectangular glasses, black suit and open white shirt, black over-ear headphones on neck, professional DJ at the bronze and dark wood console.

baobao.description: Adult Feng Baobao, exquisitely refined natural face, very long straight jet-black hair, clear dark eyes, neutral unbothered expression, pale grey-blue simple work shirt.

shayan.description: Adult Feng Shayan, exquisite confident face, short icy lavender bob and side fringe, matching tailored lavender suit and modest smooth pale lavender high-neck top, seated second-row VIP guest.

qing.description: Adult Zhuge Qing, navy-blue layered hair, narrow smiling foxlike eyes, small beauty mark, charcoal embroidered tailored jacket, open white collar and small green jade pendant. Plain matte-black wireless microphone with black grille when performing.

wang.description: Adult Wang Ye, casual dark high topknot, intelligent sleepy half-lidded dark eyes, relaxed low eyebrows, indigo hip-length wrap jacket over white crew-neck tee and separate indigo trousers. For this episode he is a quiet guqin player. Take only his face, hair and costume from the portrait; the first frame defines the guqin, empty hands and seated position. No handheld or stand microphone, no speech, no singing.

xia_he.description: Adult stage Xia He, shoulder-length rose-pink hair with sweeping long side fringe, green almond eyes, composed alluring half smile, elegant defined cheekbones. Ivory tailored jacket over a deep-plum silk wrap blouse, charcoal high-waisted trousers; refined cinematic CG. This episode: solo female chorus performer, anatomical RIGHT hand holds matte-black wireless mic below chin; use the matching chorus composition for performance, not the mic-free identity portrait.

lv_liang.description: Adult stage Lv Liang, short rounded chestnut-black bowl haircut, thin round wire glasses, alert amber-gold eyes and a controlled mischievous smile. Moss-green open overshirt over pale-sage crew-neck shirt, dark trousers; refined cinematic CG.

shen_chong.description: Adult stage Shen Chong, charcoal-black longer uneven layered fringe, thin rectangular glasses, narrow grey-brown eyes, long angular face and calculating restraint. Charcoal tailored blazer over deep grey-violet open-neck collared shirt; refined cinematic CG.

lu_linglong.description: Adult stage Lu Linglong, long warm-pink hair, separated forward fringe and a small upward cowlick, bright blue eyes, open oval face and candid expression. Ivory short jacket with warm-pink piping over ivory crew-neck top, light taupe high-waisted trousers; refined cinematic CG.

zhi_jinhua.description: Adult stage Zhi Jinhua, long straight blue-black hair with separated fringe, thin dark-red rectangular glasses, perceptive brown eyes, elegant long-oval face and knowing slight smile. Violet collared blouse with rolled sleeves, pale stone-grey trousers and dark belt; refined cinematic CG.

feng_xingtong.description: Adult stage Feng Xingtong, short silver-white center-parted swept-back hair, loose temple strands, friendly grey eyes and calm slight smile. Charcoal stand-collar zip jacket with muted-lime sleeve stripes, dark tee and dark trousers.

jia_zhengliang.description: Adult stage Jia Zhengliang, crimson-red spiky swept-back hair with two long cheek strands, amber-orange eyes, strong brows, firm angular jaw, earnest grounded confidence. Black hooded raised-collar jacket, ivory tee and dark trousers.
